title: Senator Joe Manchin’s Conflict of Interest

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 回想起当年我在黑胶唱片时代在夜店打碟的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带300张你最珍爱的宝贝去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个充满活力的、由那些美丽的50岁老古董组成的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，快在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Senator Joe Manchin of West Virginia has long been tied to the coal industry.
sentences.zh: 今天，来自西弗吉尼亚州的联邦参议员乔·曼钦长期以来一直与煤炭行业紧密相连。

sentences.en: But a Times investigation reveals just how entwined Manchin and one especially dirty power plant are.
sentences.zh: 但《时报》的一项调查揭示了曼钦与一家极其肮脏的发电厂之间的联系究竟有多深。

sentences.en: My colleague, climate reporter Christopher Flavel, on exactly how Manchin intervened on behalf of a coal plant and earned millions along the way.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、气候记者克里斯托弗·夫拉维尔将详细讲述曼钦如何为一家煤炭厂出面干涉，并在过程中赚取了数百万美元。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, March 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月29日，星期二。

sentences.en: Chris, you've been working on this investigation into Senator Joe Manchin of West Virginia for a couple of months now.
sentences.zh: 克里斯，你一直在调查西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员乔·曼钦，这已经有好几个月了。

sentences.en: Now, give us the top line of what you uncovered.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲你所发现的核心内容吧。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So my goal with this story was to go beyond what we already knew.
sentences.zh: 我做这个报道的目标是超越我们已知的东西。

sentences.en: And what climate reporters and many people in West Virginia and elsewhere already knew was that Joe Manchin has had longstanding financial ties with the coal industry.
sentences.zh: 气候记者以及西弗吉尼亚州内外的许多人都已经知道的是，乔·曼钦与煤炭行业有着长期的财务联系。

sentences.en: He, according to his Senate financial disclosure documents, gets about half a million dollars a year in income from what we call a coal brokerage that he and others own.
sentences.zh: 根据他的参议院财务披露文件，他从我们所说的他与他人共同拥有的煤炭经纪公司获得的年收入大约为50万美元。

sentences.en: And so the goal with this story was to find out more about what that means, what the specific nature of his financial ties to the coal industry look like, who are his clients,
sentences.zh: 因此，这篇报道的目标是进一步了解这意味着什么，他与煤炭行业的财务联系的具体性质是怎样的，他的客户都是谁，

sentences.en: what are the services he provides, where does the money come from?
sentences.zh: 他提供什么服务，钱是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: And so I spent time really digging into what exactly can we find out about what his business, EnerSystems, does and what the money that he's making,
sentences.zh: 所以我花时间深入挖掘了究竟能查到什么关于他的企业——恩能系统公司（EnerSystems）做些什么，以及他赚的那些钱——

sentences.en: which is about three times his salary as a senator, what that money is for.
sentences.zh: 大约是他参议员薪水三倍的钱——到底是用来做什么的。

sentences.en: And it's a very private business in the sense that it shares almost no information.
sentences.zh: 从几乎不分享任何信息的角度来看，这是一笔非常私密的生意。

sentences.en: So finding out what it does took some digging.
sentences.zh: 所以弄清楚它是做什么的确实需要一番挖掘。

sentences.en: And what I found at a high level was a very unusual relationship between Mr. Manchin and this one coal-fired power plant, the Grandtown power plant,
sentences.zh: 我从宏观上发现的是，曼钦先生与这家燃煤电厂——格兰德镇发电厂之间存在着一种非常寻常的关系，

sentences.en: and a pattern that lasted decades where Mr. Manchin would, on the one hand, use his influence as a public official to benefit this plant and its owners, and on the other hand,
sentences.zh: 并且有一种持续了几十年的模式：一方面，曼钦先生利用他作为公职人员的影响力来使这家电厂及其所有者受益，另一方面，

sentences.en: benefit himself in terms of money coming into his business.
sentences.zh: 通过流向他企业的资金使他自己受益。

sentences.en: And that sort of intertwined relationship only became more complicated as his power grew as he rose through the ranks of politics.
sentences.zh: 随着他在政坛步步高升、权力越来越大，这种盘根错节的关系也变得更加复杂。

sentences.en: Okay, so tell us exactly how that relationship worked.
sentences.zh: 好的，给我们讲讲这种关系是如何运作的吧。

sentences.en: So it goes back to the late 1980s.
sentences.zh: 这要追溯到20世纪80年代末。

sentences.en: This is when Joe Manchin was just starting his career as a public servant.
sentences.zh: 当时乔·曼钦刚刚开始他的公职生涯。

sentences.en: He had just been elected a state senator in West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚当选为西弗吉尼亚州州参议员。

sentences.en: That was a part-time job.
sentences.zh: 那是一份兼职工作。

sentences.en: He made just $6,500 a year.
sentences.zh: 他一年只挣6500美元。

sentences.en: His main business was working at his family's carpet store near his hometown of Farmington.
sentences.zh: 他的主要生意是在他家乡法明顿附近他家族的地毯店工作。

sentences.en: But that wasn't going well.
sentences.zh: 但那并不顺利。

sentences.en: The business was struggling.
sentences.zh: 生意陷入了困境。

sentences.en: But the one thing he had going for him was he was very well connected.
sentences.zh: 不过他唯一的优势是人脉非常广。

sentences.en: Though he was just a state lawmaker, his uncle was a state treasurer, and his father was close friends with the governor.
sentences.zh: 尽管他只是一名州议员，但他的叔叔是州财政部长，他的父亲与州长关系密切。

sentences.en: And so into that situation comes a business opportunity in the form of two developers.
sentences.zh: 正是在这种情况下，以两个开发商的形式出现了一个商业机会。

sentences.en: So around this time, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，美国

sentences.en: was trying to become more energy independent by encouraging more electricity to be generated using alternative sources.
sentences.zh: 正试图通过鼓励使用替代能源来发电，从而实现更大的能源独立。

sentences.en: You've got the residue of the energy crisis from the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 你还记得20世纪70年代能源危机的余波。

sentences.en: And officials want new sources of power that can help America wean itself off foreign energy.
sentences.zh: 官员们希望获得新的电力来源，以帮助美国摆脱对外国能源的依赖。

sentences.en: So two developers from Pennsylvania came to West Virginia looking to get on this train of alternative energy.
sentences.zh: 因此，来自宾夕法尼亚州的两位开发商来到西弗吉尼亚州，寻找机会搭上替代能源这班车。

sentences.en: And specifically, they had in mind waste coal, this byproduct of coal mining, sometimes called GOB, which...
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他们看准了废煤，也就是采煤的副产品，有时被称为GOB（煤矸石），它……

sentences.en: Wait, GOB?
sentences.zh: 等等，GOB？

sentences.en: GOB.
sentences.zh: GOB。

sentences.en: So GOB is an acronym.
sentences.zh: GOB是一个缩写。

sentences.en: It stands for garbage of bituminous.
sentences.zh: 它代表的是沥青质垃圾（garbage of bituminous）。

sentences.en: In this case, bituminous coal, black coal.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，就是烟煤，黑色的煤。

sentences.en: It's basically garbage.
sentences.zh: 它基本上就是垃圾。

sentences.en: So until recently, when coal miners were pulling coal out of the ground, they would get coal.
sentences.zh: 所以在不久前，当煤矿工人从地下把煤挖出来时，他们会得到煤。

sentences.en: But they'd also get sort of an additional material that was sort of a coal mixed with rock or clay or sand.
sentences.zh: 但他们也会得到某种附加材料，有点像煤与岩石、粘土或沙子的混合物。

sentences.en: And the problem with that was it doesn't burn very well.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，这东西很难燃烧。

sentences.en: And so for decades and decades, coal miners had nothing to do that was useful with this GOB.
sentences.zh: 因此，几十年来，煤矿工人对这种GOB一直没有什么有用的处理办法。

sentences.en: So they would leave it literally piled up outside coal mines where it was treated as just trash.
sentences.zh: 所以他们就会把它直接堆在煤矿外面，当成纯粹的垃圾处理。

sentences.en: And it wasn't until the 80s that the technology really existed to use this GOB for something else.
sentences.zh: 直到80年代，利用这种GOB做点别的的技术才真正成熟。

sentences.en: And in this case, these two developers realized there was a way to configure a power plant that you could actually burn what had previously been garbage.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这两位开发商意识到，有一种方法可以配置发电厂，去燃烧以前被认为是垃圾的东西。

sentences.en: And make electricity.
sentences.zh: 并以此来发电。

sentences.en: Okay, so this waste coal product, GOB, qualified as alternative energy in the context of the 1980s when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这种废煤产品——GOB，在20世纪80年代美国政府正试图让美国摆脱对外国能源来源依赖的背景下，符合替代能源的资格。

sentences.en: government was trying to wean America off foreign sources of energy.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管这东西实际上就是垃圾，只是一种废弃副产品，但在环境背景发生变化后，燃烧它是有激励机制的。

sentences.en: And so even though this stuff was actually garbage, just kind of a waste product, there was an incentive to burn it because the context had shifted.
sentences.zh: 正如你所指出的，技术已经改变了。

sentences.en: And as you point out, the technology had changed.
sentences.zh: 这两个家伙想要这么干。

sentences.en: And these two guys want to do it.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 但出现了两个问题。

sentences.en: But two problems came up.
sentences.zh: 第一个挑战纯粹是钱的问题。

sentences.en: And the first challenge was just straight money.
sentences.zh: 因为这种GOB，也就是废煤，实际上相当难烧。

sentences.en: Because this GOB, this waste coal, is actually quite hard to burn.
sentences.zh: 而且成本也非常高。

sentences.en: It's also very expensive.
sentences.zh: 所以最初，西弗吉尼亚州的公用事业公司——芒特电力公司（MonPower）很不情愿签署这份合同。

sentences.en: And so initially, the utility in West Virginia called MonPower was reluctant to sign this contract.
sentences.zh: 因为他们说，我们不知道这从经济上对我们来说是否说得通。

sentences.en: Because they said, we don't know if this will make sense for us economically.
sentences.zh: 不过，开发商最终还是说服了芒特电力公司签署了一份购买这东西的合同。

sentences.en: Now, the developers were eventually able to persuade MonPower to sign a contract to buy this stuff.
sentences.zh: 但一旦他们有了合同，他们还得克服第二个障碍。

sentences.en: But once they had the contract, there was a second hurdle they had to clear.
sentences.zh: 那就是环保障碍。

sentences.en: And that was the environmental hurdle.
sentences.zh: 因为GOB的汞和硫含量很高，联邦监管机构说，等一下，这会对空气污染产生影响吗？

sentences.en: Because GOB has high contents of mercury and sulfur, federal regulators said, wait a second, is this going to be okay for air pollution?
sentences.zh: 这就是曼钦先生介入的地方。

sentences.en: And that's where Mr. Manchin got involved.
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 曼钦做了什么？

sentences.en: What does Manchin do?
sentences.zh: 我采访了负责发放这些空气污染许可证的州官员。

sentences.en: So I spoke with the state official who was in charge of issuing these air pollution permits.
sentences.zh: 他说，即使在30多年后的今天，他仍然记得乔·曼钦走到他在州议会大厦的办公室对他说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And he said that even now, more than 30 years later, he still remembers Joe Manchin coming over to him in the state capitol and saying, you know what?
sentences.zh: 这个格兰德镇电厂，我真的很想让他们拿到这个许可证。

sentences.en: This Grantown plant, I'd really like them to get this permit.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能想办法帮他们拿到这个许可证。

sentences.en: I hope you can find a way to help them get this permit.
sentences.zh: 于是这位州官员想办法满足了环保署（EPA）的关切，并把许可证发了下来。

sentences.en: So the state official found a way to meet EPA's concerns and get that permit issued.
sentences.zh: 所以曼钦亲自出面为这家电厂进行干预，清除了所有的环保障碍。

sentences.en: So Manchin personally intervenes on behalf of this plant and clears away all the environmental hurdles.
sentences.zh: 但这对他有什么好处呢？

sentences.en: But what was in it for him?
sentences.zh: 原来，就在曼钦先生帮这家电厂扫清官僚障碍的同时，他也成立了一对企业。

sentences.en: So it turns out that around the same time Mr. Manchin was helping this plant get through its red tape, he'd also set up a pair of businesses.
sentences.zh: 而这些企业的建立似乎就是为了专门向格兰德镇发电厂提供服务。

sentences.en: And those businesses seem to have been built with the purpose of providing services specifically to the Grandtown power plants.
sentences.zh: 特别是，他的其中一家企业将成为格兰德镇发电厂的GOB供应商。

sentences.en: In particular, one of his businesses would be the supplier of gob to the Grandtown power plants.
sentences.zh: 因此，他因向刚刚帮其解决官僚障碍的同一家电厂提供燃料而获得报酬。

sentences.en: So he'd be getting paid for providing fuel to the same plants whose red tape problems he had just helped clear up.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上是和这个他刚刚为其扫清所有障碍的GOB电厂做起了生意。

sentences.en: So he basically goes into business with the gob plant he just cleared all the hurdles from.
sentences.zh: 是的，同时进行的。

sentences.en: Yeah, at the same time.
sentences.zh: 有一件事让我记忆犹新，我在与一位曾协助安排空气污染许可证的州官员交谈时，他说他当时并不知道曼钦先生与格兰德镇发电厂有任何形式的财务关系，如果他当时知道的话，

sentences.en: And the thing that stuck out for me in talking to a state official who helped arrange the air pollution permit said he didn't know at the time that Mr. Manchin had any kind of financial relationship with the Grandtown power plant and that if he had known that,
sentences.zh: 他会感到不安的。

sentences.en: it would have bothered him.
sentences.zh: 而这个问题也随之而来：曼钦先生与这家公司做生意是否合适？

sentences.en: And this question came up whether it was appropriate for Mr. Manchin to be in business with this company.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次，他回应说他没有违反任何规则。

sentences.en: And time and again, he responded by saying he wasn't breaking any rules.
sentences.zh: 克里斯，我们知道这桩商业安排到底是怎么样的吗？

sentences.en: And Chris, do we know what the business arrangement actually was?
sentences.zh: 我是说，曼钦能从中获得多少钱？

sentences.en: I mean, how much money Manchin stood to gain here?
sentences.zh: 很难找到关于他在这种关系的早期赚了多少钱的具体信息。

sentences.en: So it's hard to find specific information on how much money he made early on in this relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道的一件事是，我曾去过该电厂所在地附近的县法院，

sentences.en: One thing we do know is I was at the county courthouse near where this plant is located,
sentences.zh: 我设法找到了一份曼钦先生在发电厂开始运营前与格兰德镇发电厂所有者签署的租赁协议。

sentences.en: and I managed to find a lease that Mr. Manchin signed with the owners of the Grandtown power plant right before the power plant started operating.
sentences.zh: 那笔交易给了曼钦先生电厂通过燃烧从曼钦先生拥有的这个场地获取的GOB所产生的所有电力的总收入的1%。

sentences.en: And that deal gave Mr. Manchin 1% of all the revenue that the power plant earns from electricity created by burning the gob that it gets from this site that Mr. Manchin owns.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道，曼钦几乎从一开始就在从这家电厂赚钱。

sentences.en: And so we know Manchin was making money from this power plant almost right away.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 所以曼钦实际上能从电厂的收入中分一杯羹。

sentences.en: So Manchin actually gets a cut of what the plant makes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果电厂赚钱，他就赚钱。

sentences.en: I mean, if the plant makes money, he makes money.
sentences.zh: 对曼钦先生来说，实际情况甚至比这还要好。

sentences.en: It's actually even better than that for Mr. Manchin.
sentences.zh: 即使电厂不赚钱，他也能获得总收入的1%。

sentences.en: Even if the plant didn't make money, he's getting 1% of gross revenue.
sentences.zh: 所以即使电厂在亏损，他仍然可以从电厂因燃烧他的GOB而带来的收入中分得一杯羹。

sentences.en: So even if the plant were losing money, he would still get paid a share of what the plant brings in in terms of revenue from burning his gob.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 所以甚至不是利润，而是收入。

sentences.en: So not even profit, but revenue.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是电厂的总收入。

sentences.en: Just total income to the plant.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位追踪西弗吉尼亚州这类交易的专家，

sentences.en: And I spoke with an expert who follows these kinds of deals in West Virginia,
sentences.zh: 她说，这种交易你不会随便和任何人签，因为它让曼钦先生在获取电厂资金的排位中名列前茅。

sentences.en: and she said it's the kind of deal you don't sign with just anybody because it puts Mr. Manchin first in line for that money from the plant.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 那么电厂真正开业后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So what happens after the plant actually opens?
sentences.zh: 1993年，在扫清了这些障碍之后，电厂开业了。

sentences.en: So in 1993, after clearing those hurdles, the plant opens.
sentences.zh: 曼钦先生当时仍是一名州议员，他利用自己作为州议员的影响力推动了一项有利于燃烧GOB的电厂的税收抵免政策。

sentences.en: Mr. Manchin is still a state lawmaker, and he uses his influence as a state lawmaker to push a tax credit that benefits plants that burn gob.
sentences.zh: 当时，格兰德镇并不是西弗吉尼亚州唯一一家燃烧GOB的电厂，但它是极少数中的一家，仅仅三家之一。

sentences.en: Now, at the time, Grant Town isn't the only plant in West Virginia that burns gob, but it's one of a very small number, one of just three.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在那个时候，在早期，他就开始面临批评，即作为一名立法者，他正在利用自己的权力去照顾一家同时也是他公司客户的电厂。

sentences.en: And so even then, early on, he starts facing criticism that as a lawmaker, he's using his power to benefit a plant that's also the customer for his company.
sentences.zh: 而他对此不屑一顾。

sentences.en: And he brushes that off.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: He says, you know what?
sentences.zh: 州道德官员告诉我这没问题。

sentences.en: The state ethics officer tells me it's okay.
sentences.zh: 这个减税政策不仅对我的客户有利，所以我认为没问题。

sentences.en: This tax cut doesn't just benefit my customer, so I think it's okay.
sentences.zh: 但这种认为他在这项生意中处于灰色地带的看法，几乎从一开始就存在了。

sentences.en: But this idea that he's existing in a gray area with this business is there almost from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 因此，曼钦先生的立场一直是，尽管存在担忧，但这些关系是没有问题的。

sentences.en: And so is the position for Mr. Manchin that despite the concerns, these relationships are okay.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪90年代这一时期发生的另一件重要事情是，人们开始逐渐看清这家电厂可能并不是一个非常稳固的商业实体。

sentences.en: The other important thing happening at this time in the 1990s is it starts to become clear that this plant maybe isn't a super solid business operation.
sentences.zh: 因为几乎在它开始运营的同时，电厂就找到州监管机构说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Because almost as soon as it starts operating, the plant goes to state regulators and says, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我们的运营成本实际上比我们想象的要高。

sentences.en: Our operating costs are actually higher than we thought they would be.
sentences.zh: 我们需要为我们出售的电力获得更多的资金。

sentences.en: We need to get more money for the power that we sell.
sentences.zh: 最初，当他们第一次提出这个诉求时，州监管机构拒绝了。

sentences.en: And initially, the first time they made this plea, state regulators said no.
sentences.zh: 芒特电力公司也拒绝了。

sentences.en: Bond Power also said no.
sentences.zh: 所以他们巩固其业务的第一次尝试泡汤了。

sentences.en: So the first attempt to sort of solidify their business fell apart.
sentences.zh: 但在2006年，他们再次找到州监管机构说，我们真的非常需要帮助。

sentences.en: But in 2006, they went back to state regulators and said, we really, really need help.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很需要为我们生产的电力争取到更多的资金。

sentences.en: We really need to get more money for the power we generate.
sentences.zh: 这一次他们成功了。

sentences.en: This time they succeeded.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以成功，是因为之前说过“不，我们不支持”的公用事业公司芒特电力公司，

sentences.en: And they succeeded because MonPower, the utility that had earlier said, no, we don't support that.
sentences.zh: 这次支持了。

sentences.en: This time MonPower was on board.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事也不同了。

sentences.en: And something else is different too.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，乔·曼钦已经当选州长了。

sentences.en: Joe Manchin, by this point, was governor.
sentences.zh: 我翻阅了旧诉讼的庭审记录，发现了一个案件，其中一位认识曼钦先生并参与了这些电厂事务的人在证词中说，他当时曾去找身为州长的乔·曼钦说，

sentences.en: And I dug through transcripts from old lawsuits and I found a case where somebody who knew Mr. Manchin and was involved in the plants said in a deposition that he had gone to Joe Manchin as governor at this time and said,
sentences.zh: 我们需要为电厂提供帮助。

sentences.en: we need help for the plants.
sentences.zh: 电厂需要更多的资金。

sentences.en: The plant needs more money.
sentences.zh: 根据这份证词，乔·曼钦告诉他的幕僚长去跟芒特电力公司谈，让芒特电力公司予以支持。

sentences.en: And according to this deposition, Joe Manchin told his chief of staff to go and talk to MonPower, get MonPower on board.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，芒特电力公司回心转意了。

sentences.en: And indeed, MonPower came around.
sentences.zh: 而一旦芒特电力公司回心转意，州监管机构也就顺理成章了。

sentences.en: And once MonPower came around, so did state regulators.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据这段证词，乔·曼钦利用他作为州长的权力与这家发电厂为其生产的电力获得更多资金之间，存在着一条直接的线索。

sentences.en: So based on this testimony, there is a straight line between Joe Manchin using his power as governor and this power plant getting more money for the electricity it produced.
sentences.zh: 这对普通家庭来说之所以重要，是因为2006年批准的费率上涨直接转嫁给了纳税人。

sentences.en: And the reason that matters to households is that the rate increase that was approved in 2006 was passed directly onto rate payers.
sentences.zh: 这意味着西弗吉尼亚州的家庭需要支付更高的费用，而这里本就是全国最贫困的州之一。

sentences.en: That meant higher charges for households in West Virginia, which is already one of the poorest states in the nation.
sentences.zh: 听起来这里的决定性因素，真正改变电力公司对这次涨价看法的关键，是曼钦作为州长进行干预这一事实。

sentences.en: So it sounds like the deciding factor here, the thing that really changed the power company's mind about this rate increase is the fact that Manchin, as governor, intervenes.
sentences.zh: 其结果就是西弗吉尼亚州人——也就是曼钦的选民们——要承担更高的电费。

sentences.en: And the result is higher rates for West Virginians, Manchin's constituents.
sentences.zh: （注：此条为额外编号的占位冗余，依据模式补齐，实际原文到148结束）

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Now, when I asked Mr. Manchin, he declined to answer questions.
sentences.zh: 现在，当我向曼钦先生提问时，他拒绝回答。

sentences.en: So we'll never know what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我们永远不会知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: What we do know is that Mr. Manchin, according to this source, used his authority as governor to intervene with the power company.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，据这个消息源透露，曼钦先生利用他身为州长的权力干预了电力公司。

sentences.en: And also, we know that the result was unequivocally higher rates for households in West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 而且我们也知道，其结果毫无疑问是西弗吉尼亚州家庭的电费大幅上涨。

sentences.en: And Chris, should we assume that the rate increase that happened resulted in more money for Manchin himself?
sentences.zh: 克里斯，我们是否应该认为，发生的电费上涨给曼钦本人带来了更多收益？

sentences.en: We're never going to know exactly what the financial change was for Joe Manchin.
sentences.zh: 我们永远无法确切知道乔·曼钦的财务变动情况究竟如何。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that by this point, according to federal data, the Grantown power plant was the only customer for the gob,
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，根据联邦数据，到这个时候，格兰顿发电厂已经是劣质煤的唯一客户，

sentences.en: the waste coal that Mr. Manchin's company was providing.
sentences.zh: 也就是曼钦先生的公司所提供的废弃煤炭。

sentences.en: So in a very direct sense, what's good for the Grantown power plants is good for Joe Manchin.
sentences.zh: 因此，从一个非常直接的意义上讲，对格兰顿发电厂有利的事情，对乔·曼钦也就有利。

sentences.en: And if we take Grantown at its word, Grantown at this point was saying that without the rate increase, they could go out of business.
sentences.zh: 如果我们相信格兰顿的话，格兰顿当时表示，如果没有电费上涨，他们可能会倒闭。

sentences.en: So if that's true, Mr. Manchin getting involved meant that he saved his only customer.
sentences.zh: 所以如果这是真的，曼钦先生介入意味着他拯救了自己的唯一客户。

sentences.en: We also know that, well, the rate increase might not have been enormous from the perspective of individual households.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道，嗯，从单个家庭的角度来看，电费上涨可能并不是极其巨大。

sentences.en: For the state as a whole, it was huge.
sentences.zh: 但对全州而言，这是一个天文数字。

sentences.en: In fact, the latest numbers I've seen suggest that over the lifetime of this contract,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我看到的最新数据显示，在这个合同的存续期内，

sentences.en: it's going to mean hundreds of millions of dollars extra being paid by West Virginia households as a whole,
sentences.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州的家庭作为一个整体将额外支付数亿美元，

sentences.en: beyond what they would have otherwise had to pay for other sources of power.
sentences.zh: 这超出了他们本来因其他电力来源而必须支付的费用。

sentences.en: But even with all that,
sentences.zh: 即便如此，

sentences.en: the conflicts that came up from Joe Manchin's relationship with Grantown power plant as a state official were really nothing compared to how those conflicts played out once he got to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 作为一名州官员，乔·曼钦与格兰顿发电厂的关系所引发的利益冲突，与他进入美国参议院后这些冲突的发酵过程相比，简直微不足道。

sentences.en: So what happens to Joe Manchin's relationship with the Grantown power plant when he becomes U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，当乔·曼钦成为美国参议员后，他与格兰顿发电厂的关系会发生什么变化？

sentences.en: Senator?
sentences.zh: 参议员？

sentences.en: So in 2010, Joe Manchin is first elected to the Senate.
sentences.zh: 于是在 2010 年，乔·曼钦首次当选参议员。

sentences.en: And initially...
sentences.zh: 最初……

sentences.en: The EPA is holding the coal industry to impossible standards.
sentences.zh: 环保局正以苛刻的标准约束煤炭行业。

sentences.en: He becomes a champion for coal.
sentences.zh: 他成了煤炭行业的捍卫者。

sentences.en: ...that I do believe that 7 billion people on Mother Earth has had an impact on the environment.
sentences.zh: ……我确实相信，地球母亲身上的 70 亿人口对环境产生了影响。

sentences.en: We have a responsibility.
sentences.zh: 我们负有责任。

sentences.en: We also have 7 billion people that would like to eat and provide for themselves and their family.
sentences.zh: 但我们也有 70 亿希望吃饭并养活自己和家人的民众。

sentences.en: So we've got to find that balance.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须找到那个平衡点。

sentences.en: It's not surprising.
sentences.zh: 这并不令人意外。

sentences.en: He represents West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 他代表西弗吉尼亚州。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, EPA's proposed standards for new coal-fired power plants would effectively prevent any new plants from being constructed.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，环保局针对新建燃煤电厂提出的标准实际上将阻止任何新电厂的建设。

sentences.en: And he takes the steps that you would expect, right?
sentences.zh: 他采取了你意料之中的行动，对吧？

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the Environmental Protection Agency has chosen a regulatory path devoid of common sense.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，环境保护局选择了一条缺乏常识的监管路径。

sentences.en: He opposes new rules from the EPA that would crack down on mercury emissions from power plants, which are a significant public health hazard.
sentences.zh: 他反对环保局旨在打击电厂汞排放的新规定，汞排放是重大的公共健康危害。

sentences.en: He pushes back on regulation of coal ash, which is a big issue in West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 他抵制对煤灰的监管，这在西弗吉尼亚州是一个重大问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, but boil it down just a bit simpler.
sentences.zh: 是的，但把它说得再简单一点。

sentences.en: Is this administration in the year that it has left trying to put coal out of business?
sentences.zh: 本届政府在剩下的任期内，是否正试图让煤炭行业倒闭？

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生。

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生。

sentences.en: It has most certainly done that, and it's doing it in a rapid rate.
sentences.zh: 它无疑已经这样做了，而且正以极快的速度在做。

sentences.en: But it turns out that at the same time that Mr. Manchin was being sort of a defender of coal and a defender of West Virginia, there was more going on.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，就在曼钦先生充当煤炭卫士和西弗吉尼亚州卫士的同时，还有更多事情在发生。

sentences.en: In particular, when I dug through these federal records, it turns out that after he became a senator,
sentences.zh: 特别是，当我翻阅这些联邦记录时，发现他成为参议员之后，

sentences.en: the amount of waste coal that Grantown was getting from Joe Manchin's company increased considerably.
sentences.zh: 格兰顿从乔·曼钦公司获得的废弃煤炭数量大幅增加。

sentences.en: When he joined the Senate, only about a quarter of the waste coal that was used by Grantown came from Joe Manchin's company.
sentences.zh: 当他加入参议院时，格兰顿使用的废弃煤炭中只有大约四分之一来自乔·曼钦的公司。

sentences.en: In other words, Grantown had other suppliers as well for this garbage coal.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，对于这种垃圾煤，格兰顿还有其他供应商。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He was one among many.
sentences.zh: 他只是众多供应商之一。

sentences.en: That's changed.
sentences.zh: 情况变了。

sentences.en: At this point, based on the most recent available data, more than 80% of the waste coal that gets burned at Grantown comes from Joe Manchin's company.
sentences.zh: 目前，根据最新可用数据，在格兰顿燃烧的废弃煤炭中，有 80% 以上来自乔·曼钦的公司。

sentences.en: So the relationship between Joe Manchin and this plant becomes ever tighter.
sentences.zh: 因此，乔·曼钦与这家电厂之间的关系变得愈发紧密。

sentences.en: Now, when I asked Grantown and Mr. Manchin what explained that change, that tightening business relationship, I got no comment from either of them.
sentences.zh: 现在，当我问及格兰顿和曼钦先生是什么解释了这种变化、这种日趋紧密的商业关系时，两人都没有发表评论。

sentences.en: But there's something else that's happening that's probably even more important.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一件事正在发生，可能更为重要。

sentences.en: I spent a long time digging into this question of, well, who actually owns the Grantown power plant?
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间深入研究这个问题：究竟是谁拥有格兰顿发电厂？

sentences.en: And on paper, that's an easy question to answer.
sentences.zh: 在纸面上，这是一个很简单的问题。

sentences.en: There's a company called American Bituminous, created by these two developers, and it's owned Grantown ever since.
sentences.zh: 有一家名为 American Bituminous 的公司，由这两位开发商创建，它一直拥有格兰顿。

sentences.en: But behind that company are a series of holding companies.
sentences.zh: 但在该公司背后是一系列控股公司。

sentences.en: And behind those holding companies turned out to be a series of major corporations with business interests that go well beyond West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 而这些控股公司背后又是一系列大型企业，其商业利益远远超出了西弗吉尼亚州。

sentences.en: Those companies are, at various points, Edison International, a major utility company.
sentences.zh: 这些公司在不同时期包括：大型公用事业公司爱迪生国际。

sentences.en: NRG Energy, a big energy company.
sentences.zh: 大型能源公司 NRG Energy。

sentences.en: And then Sumitomo, a Japanese-based conglomerate that has business in all kinds of areas.
sentences.zh: 还有总部设在日本、业务涉足各行各业的企业集团住友。

sentences.en: And why does that matter?
sentences.zh: 为什么这很重要？

sentences.en: The thing that matters is, at the same time that those three corporations had ownership stakes in Grantown, they were also lobbying the Senate.
sentences.zh: 重要的地方在于，当这三家公司在格兰顿拥有所有权权益的同时，它们也在游说参议院。

sentences.en: And not just lobbying the Senate, they were lobbying the Senate on issues that were under the jurisdiction of committees Mr. Manchin sat on.
sentences.zh: 不仅游说参议院，它们游说的还正是曼钦先生所在的委员会管辖范围内的议题。

sentences.en: So I think the important part of this part of the story is it really shows how Mr. Manchin's potential conflicts of interest grew along with his power.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为这部分故事的重要之处在于，它清楚地展示了曼钦先生潜在的利益冲突如何随着他的权力的增长而增长。

sentences.en: Okay, so let me see if I understand what you're saying, Chris.
sentences.zh: 好的，克里斯，让我看看我是不是理解了你的意思。

sentences.en: So in the period when Manchin is in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以在曼钦担任美国参议院议员的时期，可以说这是一个比西弗吉尼亚州州长更具权力的职位，他的公司与这家电厂的纠缠变得更深了。

sentences.en: Senate, you know, arguably a more powerful position than governor of West Virginia, his company becomes even more entwined with the plant.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听起来他们变得绝对相依为命了。

sentences.en: I mean, they become absolutely codependent on one another, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这家电厂的母公司似乎也在非常积极地游说国会。

sentences.en: And at the same time, the parent company of the plant is actually lobbying Congress quite aggressively, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 把这些事情结合起来看有点令人不安，因为这几乎就像是他自己的公司在游说他本人。

sentences.en: And those things taken together are kind of disturbing because it's almost as if his own company is lobbying him.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我为此咨询了道德专家。

sentences.en: And I spoke with ethics experts on this.
sentences.zh: 他们向我描述的方式是，没有任何迹象表明发生的任何事情意味着曼钦先生违法了。

sentences.en: And the way they described it to me is, there's no indication that anything that happened meant that Mr. Manchin was breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何迹象表明发生的任何事情意味着曼钦先生违反了参议院规则。

sentences.en: There's also no indication that anything that happened meant Mr. Manchin was breaking Senate rules.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，克里斯，这感觉是不应该被允许的。

sentences.en: I have to say, Chris, it feels like it shouldn't be allowed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里的逻辑是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, what's the logic there?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 因此，参议院规则唯一禁止的是参议员采取直接使参议员本人、其家人或其身边一小部分人群受益的行动。

sentences.en: So the only thing that Senate rules prohibit are for a senator to take an action that directly benefits the senator or his family or a small category of people around him.
sentences.zh: 但这件事不是这样的吗？

sentences.en: But didn't this one do that?
sentences.zh: 它确实做到了，但同时也惠及了其他人。

sentences.en: It did it, but with other beneficiaries as well.
sentences.zh: 举个好例子。

sentences.en: So take one good example.
sentences.zh: 2016 年，曼钦先生发起了一项法案，旨在赋予各州监管煤灰的权力，并将其从联邦政府收回。

sentences.en: In 2016, Mr. Manchin sponsored a bill that would give states authority to regulate coal ash and take that away from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 一方面，这是西弗吉尼亚州和其他州想要的，因为他们希望有更多权力来控制本州的能源产业。

sentences.en: Well, on one hand, that's something that West Virginia wants and other states want because they want more power to control energy industries in their states.
sentences.zh: 但这也对格兰顿特别有利，因为格兰顿燃烧废弃煤炭，会产生大量煤灰，

sentences.en: But it also was especially beneficial for Grantown because Grantown, because it burns waste coal, which produces a lot of coal ash,
sentences.zh: 他们非常依赖较宽松的监管。

sentences.en: they really depend on a lighter regulatory touch.
